title: Digital Realty signs $373M power equipment deal with Schneider

sources.quote: Schneider Electric, a global energy technology leader, today announced that Digital Realty, (NYSE: DLR) the leading global provider of carrier-neutral data center, colocation, and interconnection solutions, has signed a $373 million Supply Capacity Agreement (SCA) for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), Low Voltage Switchgear (LVS), and Pre-Fabricated Skids.

explain: Data center landlord Digital Realty reserved $373 million of Schneider Electric's production of backup power systems (UPS), switchgear and prefabricated equipment skids, guaranteeing it gets the gear on time for new data centers.
